ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
091
Behind the image
61 / Cream Suite
REFERENCE 5842.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 045
Art direction: Tonal cream on cream, soft daylight, pearl and gold accents, quiet-luxury polish.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with
long, straight black hair, a cream wool beret with braided trim, delicate rimless glasses, a calm
neutral expression and soft coral lips. She wears a cream cropped jacket with a rounded Peter Pan
collar, pearl buttons and large patch pockets over a sheer ivory camisole, a matching A-line mini
skirt with triple-line hem detail, a slim belt with a small gold buckle, layered long pearl necklaces,
and holds a small cream quilted chain-strap bag. Pale warm-white plaster wall, soft diffused
daylight, tonal cream palette, quiet luxury styling, no text or logos.
62 / Khaki Bubble
REFERENCE 5841.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 046
Art direction: Safari-inspired khaki, playful volume, white seamless backdrop, bright even light.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter studio fashion portrait of an original adult East Asian woman
with long, wavy black hair, rosy flushed cheeks, soft pink lips and a cool sideways gaze under a
cream wool newsboy cap. She wears a khaki double-breasted short-sleeve top with puffed sleeves,
a rounded pointed collar, tortoiseshell buttons and a keyhole neckline, with a matching khaki
bubble-hem mini skirt and a slim silver bracelet, and holds a white and tan patterned top-handle
bag with a leopard-print fur charm. White seamless backdrop, bright even studio light, khaki and
cream palette, playful retro safari mood, no text or logos.
